capabilities: Embed web pages with external-image Markdown syntax
extras: The plugin is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is brief and lists supported services without detailed configuration or troubleshooting guidance.
problem: Obsidian only officially supports embedding a few kinds of web pages, so other external content cannot be embedded directly.
summary: Plugin that embeds Bluesky posts, GitHub Gists, and Niconico pages in notes using external-image Markdown syntax, with Live Preview support.
